Arrastra un componente de la paleta al e: Drag a component from the palette onto the schematic. Connect two pins by dragging from one to the other. Shift and drag selects several; dragging the background pans it; the wheel zooms. Tapping a switch opens or closes it.
El simulador plantea el circuito con el: The simulator sets up the circuit with modified nodal analysis: one Kirchhoff equation for each node and one more for each element that fixes a voltage (voltage sources, inductors, transformers, op-amps). With the same system it solves three analyses.
<b>Continua.</b> Se sustituye el condens: DC. The capacitor is replaced by an open circuit and the inductor by a short circuit, and each source by its DC value. With diodes and transistors it iterates with Newton-Raphson.
<b>Alterna.</b> Cada elemento se convier: AC. Each element becomes an impedance, and it is solved once for each frequency present in the sources and the effects are added (superposition).
<b>Osciloscopio.</b> Se integra en el ti: Oscilloscope. It is integrated over time with the trapezoidal rule, with the full waveform of the sources (DC plus AC), the switches and the transistors.
Al importar un circuito SPICE se traduce: When a SPICE circuit is imported, the subset the simulator supports is translated; everything else (subcircuits, switches, sources with an expression, custom analyses) is skipped and listed line by line in the import warnings.
El análisis es de circuitos lineales (co: The analysis is for linear circuits (with the ideal components of the palette): it does not compute noise or tolerance spread (Monte Carlo).
